verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a startup incorporation and back-office platform, so generating SAFEs or convertible notes is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions SAFE or convertible-note templates, generation, or e-signing. The nearby items (a Carta integration for cap tables and a VC discovery program) are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch
